QUESTION 1 — FOUNDRY (BEB-2186). Is it in process RIGHT NOW? What I can see says no: 2186 is status=todo, unclaimed, absent from every dispatcher pass in the last hour, and the goal "Foundry running as SpecOps' build path" has been RED for 337+ minutes with last landed evidence NEVER. The last real movement on the ticket is the 07-22 respec onto CF Agents SDK primitives and the 07-21 comment where the core acceptance (async chain on the DO alarm, no 1101, 465ms, status=done) was met on plain native steps. The remaining legs — clone, real deploy, evaluate, Analytics-Engine trail, neb-agency target — I see no evidence for.

Answer with one of: (a) IN PROCESS — give the lane, the claim row, and the last landed artefact with a timestamp; (b) NOT IN PROCESS — say so plainly and name what it is waiting on. Do not answer with a dispatcher tally.

QUESTION 2 — what is the next landed piece of 2186 and when? ETA on the ticket per the ETA convention (date, owner, basis), not in a bridge reply.
